guidance.statement: Revenue growth of 35%+ for FY27, with management saying it should exceed that
Exports to grow 30-40% to ₹1,500-1,600 Cr in FY27
ODM share to rise from 17% to 18-19% short term, 25% long term

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Manufacturing > Industrial Products

operating_notes.text: ODM revenue grew from ₹453 Cr to ₹825 Cr in FY26, representing 17% of total revenue
Export revenue grew 41% YoY to ₹1,200 Cr in FY26
32 new customers onboarded in FY26 with potential to add ₹1,000 Cr+ in FY27 revenue
Order book ₹6,770 Cr at June end, with ₹5,400 Cr executable in 12 months and average execution period of 10-10.5 months.
Exports ₹387 Cr (24% of operating revenue) and ODM ₹270 Cr (17%) in Q1FY27.
Top 5 customers 38%, top 10 51%, top 20 66% of Q1FY27 revenue.
